yhvh: YHVH is a name for the God of the Old Testament as transliterated from the Hebrew consonants YHVH.
YHVH means the same as Yahweh or YHWH or Yahwe.
yhwh: YHWH is a name for the God of the Old Testament as transliterated from the Hebrew consonants YHVH.
YHWH means the same as Yahweh or Yahwe or Yahveh.
